usage: The term '堂食' is used to refer to eating food inside the restaurant rather than taking it out.
'堂食' can function as a noun to distinguish from '外賣' (takeout) or delivery options.
In casual conversation, people may ask if you want '堂食' or '打包' (to pack/take out) to clarify your dining preference.
'堂食' often appears on menus or signs to specify that the food is served for dine-in customers.
While primarily a noun, '堂食' can also be used in phrases describing dining arrangements, like '堂食區' (dine-in area).
